# Greffier — proposition visuelle v1

Illustration produite avec l’outil intégré image_gen. Interprétation visuelle proposée, sans ajout automatique au canon.

Image : [greffier-v1.png](greffier-v1.png).

## Prompt

Use case: stylized-concept. Create a richly detailed painterly dark fantasy bestiary illustration of a GREFFIER, an original non-living magical CREATURE of enchantment in a medieval magical civilization. Show a clearly recognizable single autonomous creature, not merely a machine or a decorated building: a low crawling asymmetrical animal-like body made of overlapping engraved ceramic and weathered bronze plates, articulated flexible braided tendrils, small exploratory gripping extremities, and open physical couplings. Its engraved plates are functional organs bearing simple three-by-three grids, arrows and small abstract runes, not readable text. No humanoid face, no human operator, no robot head, no gears or steampunk aesthetic. It is instinctive and morally neutral, strange and beautiful rather than demonic. Scene: old stone fortress heating room, a real ember furnace glowing behind it. Full creature in three-quarter view close to ground, prominently occupying foreground, silhouette clearly separated from background. It is actively grafting a new warm ceramic plate onto its flank from an existing medieval heating conduit: one exploratory tendril touches the plate, another physically connects it to its body. Other connected plates extend along the wall like a growing ribbed tail. Subtle amber warmth travels along physically connected engraved paths from the furnace; distinct cool unconnected plates lie within reach. Show material weight, soot, cracked glaze, taut braids, clawlike attachment points, and a tiny heat shimmer; no floating magical holograms, no free energy beams. Creature anatomy readable at a glance, a compact main body with several purposeful limbs and a spreading circuit-tail. Mood: tragic grandeur, beautiful complexity, believable tactile fantasy, warm amber against cool stone, restrained luminous inscriptions. Cinematic landscape composition, exquisite illustrative craftsmanship, no caption, no text, no watermark. This is a proposed visual interpretation, not a technical diagram.
